description: This chart illustrates the performance scores of various large language models across two main evaluation sets, labeled "MATH-500" on the left and "AIME24" on the right, which are further divided into six sub-charts labeled (a) through (f). The horizontal axes display categorical labels representing model parameter sizes or unknown values (e.g., "3B", "1.5B", "405B", "671B", "7B", and "unk"). The vertical axes represent numerical values on a linear scale without explicit titles; for the MATH-500 panel, the vertical axes range from 65 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 5, while for the AIME24 panel, they range from 0 to 90 with tick marks at intervals of 10. A legend at the top indicates that solid fills correspond to "CoT" and diagonal striped fills correspond to "TTS". The legend maps specific colors and patterns to model names: blue stripes for Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, green solid for Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct, pink solid for o1-mini, gold solid for DeepSeek-R1, grey solid for o1, purple solid for GPT-4o, red stripes for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B, brown solid for o1-preview, and an orange striped box positioned next to a blank grey rectangle. In the MATH-500 panel, sub-chart (a) shows a blue striped bar at 78.2, a purple solid bar at 74.6, and a green solid bar at 71.4; sub-chart (b) displays a red striped bar at 91.6, a pink solid bar at 90.0, and a brown solid bar at 85.5; and sub-chart (c) features a gold solid bar at 97.3 (the tallest in the entire chart), an orange striped bar at 95.2, and a grey solid bar at 94.8. In the AIME24 panel, sub-chart (d) contains a blue striped bar at 30.0, a green solid bar at 23.3, and a purple solid bar at 9.3 (the shortest in the entire chart); sub-chart (e) shows a pink solid bar at 63.6, a red striped bar at 63.3, and a brown solid bar at 44.6; and sub-chart (f) includes an orange striped bar at 83.3, a gold solid bar at 79.8, and a grey solid bar at 79.2. Within each of the six sub-charts, the three bars are sorted in descending order from left to right. Additionally, every bar is visually emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it and a square graphical icon embedded near its top edge.
